# SYNESIS_E030 — Error

## Description

Value `1.5` outside the range [1.5..1.5] in the field `field_name`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The value `1.5` is outside the allowed range for the field
  `field_name`. This field only accepts values between
  `1.5` and `1.5`.
  Fix the value so it falls within this range.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **ScaleOutOfRange**: `field_name`, `value`, `min_value`, `max_value`
